entries.text: Pinehold Goods registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Pinehold Filter Kit: a replacement cartridge set for under-sink housings. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Registered product terms. Intended use: household water filtration at the kitchen tap. Billing model: the registered terms record does not state an applicable billing model for this kit.
